summary: Identity cookie is unsigned and httpOnly:false
evidence: jar.set(PERSON_COOKIE, id, {path:'/', sameSite:'lax', httpOnly:false}) — no signature, no secure flag; currentPerson() trusts the value if it names any sign-in persona
why_it_matters: Anyone can set the cookie in devtools and become any persona including administrator; every server-side authority check downstream keys off an identity nobody proved
fix: Signed session cookie at minimum; SSO at the edge properly

summary: 32 advisories / 14 high; Next pinned below patched versions

summary: CI never runs the end-to-end suite
